hero.title: Talk to {name}
hero.setup: Two steps and she can talk:
problem.no_voice_key: Add a Google Gemini or an OpenRouter key — Lura's voice (hearing and speaking) comes from Gemini 3.8.
problem.voice_provider_key_missing: The voice provider you picked has no key yet.
problem.no_brain_key: The brain you picked has no key. Add one, or pick a provider that has a key.
problem.realtime_needs_gemini: Realtime mode needs a Google Gemini key.
keys.title: API keys
keys.hint: Your keys stay on this computer, in a file only you can read. Each one is tested before it is saved.
keys.replace: paste a new key to replace it
brain.title: Brain
brain.mode.pipeline_hint: The model you pick below understands you, thinks and takes actions; Gemini 3.8 only speaks its answer, sentence by sentence while it is still being written.
brain.mode.realtime_hint: Gemini Live hears, understands and speaks in one live audio line — the fastest replies. Your model choice below is not used. Needs a Gemini key.
brain.hears: This model hears your voice directly — one step, fastest.
brain.transcribes: This model reads text, so Gemini 3.8 Flash writes down what you said first.
voice.title: Voice
voice.provider.auto: Automatic (Gemini first; OpenRouter when Gemini is busy or out of quota)
voice.model_hint: Always Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS — directly, or through OpenRouter.
lang.title: Language & you
lang.wake_hint: Heard on this computer, offline. It must be an English word; “lura” works.
conn.title: Connectors
conn.hint: MCP servers Lura can use. Chrome, web and files come with the app.
conn.name: Name
conn.json: Paste the JSON from the server's README
conn.node_hint: Command connectors run with npx, which comes with Node.js (nodejs.org).
adv.title: Advanced
adv.briefing: Morning briefing after the computer starts
adv.start_login: Start Lura when I log in
assistant.brain_error: Sorry, I couldn't reach the model just now.
assistant.hearing_error: Sorry, I couldn't hear that properly.
assistant.refused: I can't help with that one.
brain.search: Search models — e.g. claude, gpt, gemini…
brain.no_models: Add a key above to choose a model from that provider.
restart.done: Lura restarted with your new settings.
restart.timeout: Lura has not come back yet — check that it is running.
adv.subtitles: Subtitles under the face (what you say and Lura's answer) — right-click the face to toggle
audio.title: Microphone & speaker
audio.speaker: Speaker
audio.mic_quiet: Very quiet (peak {peak}). Is it muted, or the wrong microphone?
audio.follow_up: After she answers, wait for me
audio.hint: Changes apply right away. Lura listens while you talk and answers once you have been quiet for the pause above; then she waits for your next sentence, no wake word needed.
mem.title: Memory & history
mem.hint: Lura keeps every conversation and what she learns about you, so she always remembers you. It all stays on this computer, in {path}. Nothing is uploaded except what each request needs.
mem.budget: How much she carries into each conversation (tokens)
mem.facts_placeholder:
- I prefer short answers
- I work on Lura in /var/www/html/lura
mem.reset_confirm: Start a fresh thread? Lura forgets the earlier conversations and their summary (they stay in the list below and searchable). What she knows about you stays.
mem.reset_done: Fresh start. Past conversations are still in the list.
mem.no_summary: No summary yet: it is written once past conversations no longer fit in the size above.
mem.delete_all_confirm: Delete every conversation and the summary? What Lura knows about you (above) stays.
skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md: a name, a one-line description, and instructions. Lura sees the descriptions and reads a skill when a task calls for it. Works with every model, OpenRouter included.
skills.url: Link to a SKILL.md or a .zip (https)
skills.remove_confirm: Remove the {name} skill and its files?
skills.warning: A skill is instructions Lura will follow, so only add ones you trust. Any command it runs still goes through the same safety guard.
mem.changed: Lura changed her memory while you were editing. Here it is now; make your edit again.
lang.wake_unknown: The wake-word model cannot hear "{word}" (it is not in its vocabulary), so she would never wake up. Try a common English word, like a name.
lang.wake_kept: The wake word stays "{word}": the offline model cannot hear "{name}". Pick another wake word if you like.
home.live_captions: Write what I say while I'm speaking
home.live_hint: Your words appear under the face as you talk and settle when you finish. Each refresh is one extra hearing request.
brain.persona_hint: Optional. Added to how she already talks and thinks: tone, things to always do or avoid.
brain.persona_placeholder: e.g. Call me Mido. Keep technical answers precise and mention the command you ran.
brain.free_warning: Free models on OpenRouter are slower, often rate-limited, and much weaker at following a conversation. For good answers pick google/gemini-3.8-flash or another paid model.
brain.minimal_warning: Thinking is set to "minimal": faster, but she may misread follow-up questions. "Low" is the better balance.
about.title: About
about.text: Lura is free and open source (MIT). Bugs and ideas are welcome on GitHub; every change is reviewed by the maintainer.
lang.conversation_hint: Her default. She answers in whatever language you speak to her: Arabic gets Egyptian Arabic, English gets English.
lang.user_gender_hint: Arabic addresses men and women differently (إنتَ عايز / إنتِ عايزة). Her own forms follow her voice.
